name: flow_results_play_again_keeps_party
description: A party match on a server ends (MATCH_END) on the results; Play again goes back to the hub with the party intact: the same code, the same members and Builders, Ready cleared, on the same connection, which then carries the next match too.

steps.msg: Ana plays her main, the Lookout, now that her towers have views (Profile.fielded)
Play again said LEAVE_MATCH after MATCH_END: the server has my row back from the results plate

steps.assert: Session.state_name() == 'HUB' and Session.client == link_before and Session.client.phase_name() == 'WAITING'
steps.msg: back in the hub on the same connection
the party is intact: its code and both members

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').lines() == ['diamond Sascha lamplighter leader', 'circle Ana lookout', '+ invite', '+ invite']

steps.msg: the party still covers all four

steps.assert: Session.client == link_before and Session.client.match_id == 1 and Session.client.seat == 1
steps.msg: and the kept connection carries the next match
